test.description: Theme tests: the data schema, the components and the layouts, rendered in-process; plus a build of every phase of the demo

check.description: Type-check the theme and the tests, then every instance's config with its own deno.json (where the kcd-theme/ alias lives), and the demo's build script
check.command: deno check *.ts schema/*.ts scripts/*.ts tests/*.ts && cd showcase && deno check _config.ts && cd ../demo && deno check build.ts phases.ts && cd announced && deno check _config.ts && cd ../agenda && deno check _config.ts

lint.description: Lint every TypeScript file (Lume's lint plugin included)

build.description: Build the showcase on its own, then every demo milestone and the showcase under one _site/
build.command: cd showcase && deno task build && cd ../demo && deno task build

serve.description: Serve the announcement demo for theme development; theme files are watched too
